I love this app. It always makes my day a little brighter and helps me be productive. I have one complaint and also one suggestion, however. My complaint is the King Truffle Wuffle micropet. Maybe someone can explain to me why this wasn’t racist, but I feel like it’s kind of in poor taste to have a human, even an indigenous person, as a micropet. That smacks of slavery to me and really bothers me. We could have had any tropical-themed cute animal pet. It was a bit too far in my opinion to make it a human. I would really appreciate it if this micropet would be removed from the system and replaced with another one (or if I could be given an explanation for how I may have misread this situation).


Then just a suggestion to end things on a lighter note! I would really love if the developers could come up with a version of this app for couples. It would be so nice to be able to share goals more completely with a spouse or partner and see what each other needs to get done and encourage them along their self care and productivity journey. 

Thank you so much for listening to me, and I look forward to seeing where this app ends up going!

They have you open the app, create your character/critter or whatever, set up your profile, enter your name and information, take a whole quiz and THEN tell you need to pay for a subscription to access the app and its contents. And it looks like they’re pushing a yearly subscription too. Who is actually paying for all this? 🤣

I won’t even be taking my free 7 DAY trial because that’s exactly how they get people. You forget to cancel,  and suddenly you’re being charged for something you didn’t even intend to pay for. So nope! I’ll be deleting the app. 

Just wanted to share my experience before I go.😂

That being said, this is one of my favorite apps ever! It has actually really encouraged me to take care of myself. It's easy to use, no pressure, and doesn't penalize you for not taking care of yourself. It only rewards you. I'm enjoying seeing my bird and his pet grow as I take care of myself. My little bird has become a reflection of me and I see him growing. They also do a sponsorship program where you can pay for a stranger's premium subscription. Premium subscriptions offer access to extra clothes and furniture options for your bird, other breathing exercises, more soundscapes, and other activities. all the notifications are stacking up. i have to take more and more effort to keep up with this stupid app that’s supposed to make things easier! so i delete the whole thing. finch is probably one of the most overhyped apps to recommend. cmon. do better, please. i trusted you.

reviews.title: Good app. Could be more generous with Shop items.
reviews.text: I like the app. It has helped me stay focused and productive throughout the day. The only thing that really bothers me is the Shop items. If you’re a Free user, you only get 8 options in Outfit and Furniture to choose from (16 with the free re-roll). But the options are the worst options—they’re typically the most boring/generic options, and they follow the same pattern every time. All the good options require Finch Plus. Why? Free users are earning the same points in the same way as any user on Finch Plus. The items are already behind one “paywall” (in-game currency). Why put them behind two? Additionally, and maybe even more problematic, is that every item has multiple colors and each variation is a separate item. So if you see a hat you want but it’s in a color you don’t want, well, too bad. You’ll have to hope it comes up in the color you want. That is ridiculous. Just have the items and let us pick whatever color we want! The current way is designed to be exploitive—on a self-care app!

reviews.title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Finch Helped Me Find My Way Back to Myself! 💗
reviews.text:
When I first discovered Finch, I was going through a very difficult time in my life. I was struggling with depression, and even the smallest everyday tasks felt overwhelming. Things most people don’t think twice about, like getting out of bed, brushing my teeth, or taking a shower, were sometimes more than I could manage.

Those were actually some of my very first goals in Finch.

Little by little, something started to change. Every small accomplishment gave me a reason to feel proud of myself. I started adding more goals, creating routines, and finding motivation that I hadn’t felt in a long time.

I’m not going to say every day is easy, because it isn’t. There are still days when I have to convince myself to do things, especially walking my dogs! But now I have this wonderful little companion encouraging me along the way. Sometimes just wanting to check something off my list is enough to get me moving.

What started as a simple self-care app has become something I look forward to every single day. I love dressing up my Finch, decorating rooms, collecting things, and discovering new features. I check in throughout the day, and it genuinely brings me happiness.

Looking back at where I started compared to where I am today makes me emotional. I never thought an app could make such a difference in my life, but Finch has helped me rebuild routines, recognize my accomplishments, and most importantly, feel better about myself.

Finch didn’t magically make my problems disappear, but it helped me start showing up for myself again, one little goal at a time.

To the creators of Finch, thank you from the bottom of my heart. You’ve created something that is so much more than an app. 💕

reviews.title: This app actually works
reviews.text:
My patterns, habits, moods & behaviors have genuinely gotten better & more consistent using this app. I love categorizing & tracking & that I get a little weekly report but can also search for more analytics. I’ve also been loving the community polls & seasonal messages to other birbs

A couple notes with love: I miss the feature of the auto-mood log/motivation prompt. I track less without it

For goals I haven’t completed in a while or avoided I wish there was a nudge system or some other motivating factor to complete it because I start to become blind to the list

I’m not getting the red dot notification for weekly reports anymore

Activities are too many clicks away to get to, makes them out of sight out of mind when this section has so much to offer!

reviews.title: The best flippin app ever!
reviews.text: I downloaded this app a year ago when I was super depressed. I’m happy to say I don’t need it anymore, but I still use it every day. My birb Pepper has helped me so much, and so have my friends on Finch as well. I was also gifted a Team Gift sponsorship for Finch Plus which was nice. This app has smooth graphics that make it a very calm and gentle app. I like the daily questions and affirmations. It’s also fun to dress Pepper in a cute dress and send her off exploring new cities! Overall, a very nice app that I recommend to everyone!
